title: Belondar Money Mod
description: This mod adds craftable currency to Minecraft!
body:
## MONEY MOD
Welcome to the world of savings – the Belondar Money Mod! This mod adds a ton of craftable bills to your game, which you can exchange for various in-game valuables! Each banknote is divided into the banknote base and a valuable resource (for example, a diamond) to form a 50-dollar banknote!
* Supports JEI. All crafts available in JEI and Recipes Book.
# REQUIES FABRIC API 0.141.4+1.21.11
